# SideSheet

A right-side panel for details and filters that sits beside the work (non-modal) on desktop and becomes a modal bottom sheet with a grab handle on phones.

`SongNodes.SideSheet` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SideSheet open onClose={…} title={…}>…</SongNodes.SideSheet>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SideSheet" open="{{yes}}" on-close="{{…}}" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Props (SideSheetProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Close handler (close button, Esc; also scrim tap on phones). |
| `title` * | `ReactNode` | Title; may use the thin–bold lead ("Track:", "Bicep – Glue"). |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Scrollable body. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | Sticky footer actions. |
| `mode` | `"push" \| "overlay"` | Desktop behaviour: push the content aside (default) or overlay it. Phones always get a modal bottom sheet. |
| `width` | `number` | Width on tablet and desktop in px (default 380). |
